titleEn: Using a Robot to Print the Lexicographically Smallest String
title: 使用机器人打印字典序最小的字符串
summary: 依次可把 s 首字符移入机器人栈，或把栈顶打印，最终求能打印出的字典序最小字符串。
insight: 维护尚未移入字符的最小值。每压入一个字符后，只要栈顶不大于未来最小字符，就应立即打印；否则保留等待更小字符先输出。
pitfalls: 未来无字符时应清空栈
最小剩余字符随频次耗尽而推进

solutions.title: 剩余最小字符与栈
solutions.idea: 当栈顶不会被未来更小字符压过时立即输出。
steps: 统计 frequency，smallest 指向最小剩余字符
while 栈顶<=smallest（无剩余视为边界更大），弹出追加

code.java: class Solution { public String robotWithString(String s){int[] frequency=new int[26];for(char ch:s.toCharArray())frequency[ch-'a']++;int smallest=0;StringBuilder stack=new StringBuilder(),answer=new StringBuilder();for(char ch:s.toCharArray()){stack.append(ch);frequency[ch-'a']--;while(smallest<26&&frequency[smallest]==0)smallest++;while(stack.length()>0&&(smallest==26||stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)-'a'<=smallest)){answer.append(stack.charAt(stack.length()-1));stack.setLength(stack.length()-1);}}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun robotWithString(s:String):String{val frequency=IntArray(26);for(ch in s)frequency[ch-'a']++;var smallest=0;val stack=StringBuilder();val answer=StringBuilder();for(ch in s){stack.append(ch);frequency[ch-'a']--;while(smallest<26&&frequency[smallest]==0)smallest++;while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&(smallest==26||stack[stack.length-1]-'a'<=smallest)){answer.append(stack[stack.length-1]);stack.setLength(stack.length-1)}};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string robotWithString(string s){int frequency[26]={};for(char ch:s)++frequency[ch-'a'];int smallest=0;string stack,answer;for(char ch:s){stack+=ch;--frequency[ch-'a'];while(smallest<26&&!frequency[smallest])++smallest;while(!stack.empty()&&(smallest==26||stack.back()-'a'<=smallest)){answer+=stack.back();stack.pop_back();}}return answer;} };
